headline: A staged LLM pipeline reports Lean-checked runtime proofs for designed optimization algorithms
summary: An October 26 preprint reports a staged pipeline in which LLMs propose black-box optimization algorithms and construct potential functions and runtime analyses that are checked by Lean. The author reports that 12 of 15 frontier-model runs across eight problem classes completed the pipeline; nine produced polynomial query bounds without relying on uncharged offline computation. The paper reports an O(n²) result for CycleUncover and matching O(n²) order for LeadingOnes. These are preprint-reported results, not independent reproduction. The study did not empirically compare the algorithms, tested open-weight models did not complete the pipeline, the search space is restricted, and the bounds are not yet state of the art.
